incidents.name: ARK public autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens()
incidents.notes: ARK.autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() can be called by anyone to burn ARK held by the ARK/WBNB pair and sync it, so the attacker repeatedly shrank the pool and sold into the inflated price.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xde698B5BBb4A12DDf2261BbdF8e034af34399999 created 2024-03-11T16:12:47Z by 0x3b7b478d9fe6c76629d317e5708fc39a3ab9d097, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xdd309ea4e99b772c1e6a798a6b159211bb95b22c; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). ~348 BNB x $559.7/BNB at the incident timestamp 1711199895 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $194,776.
